failure_clusters.does_not_prove: That all trades experiencing MAE <= -0.75R are guaranteed to lose, but it shows that the current stop-loss geometry allows trades to run to deep adverse excursions without structural invalidation, contributing to 91.9% of total gross losses.
evidence: The deep adverse MAE cluster has a gross loss of 43.41 R across 35 losses.
The overall gross loss of the strategy is 47.20 R, meaning this cluster represents the vast majority of losses.
The average MAE of the strategy is -0.89 R, which is very close to the average loss size.

failure_clusters.does_not_prove: That a break-even stop will always improve net R, as some trades might pull back to break-even before moving to full profit targets.
evidence: The favorable-then-loss cluster has a gross loss of 24.28 R across 22 losses.
These trades reached at least 0.50 R in profit before reversing into losses, indicating a lack of active trade management or trailing stops.

hypotheses.single_axis_change: Maintain current strategy parameters without applying any entry filters from the filter screen
hypotheses.why: The filter screen candidates (such as excluding ETHUSDT or utc_06_12) lack validation on the W3 window due to insufficient trade count, making them invalid under the strict promotion criteria.

hypotheses.falsification_test: Replay historical trades with intratrade path data and verify if the reduction in gross loss from protected round-trips exceeds the loss of potential wins that would have been prematurely stopped out at break-even.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Set stop-loss to break-even once trade MFE reaches 0.50R
hypotheses.why: S08 has a significant favorable-then-loss cluster where 22 trades reached an MFE of >= 0.50R but ultimately resulted in a gross loss of 24.28R. Implementing a break-even trigger will protect capital on these round-trips.
